card.name: Tumor and cancer terms in labels
card.fires_on: The word tumor(s) or the end of a tumor/cancer term such as carcinoma or sarcoma, and linking words just after organ or disease lists. It appears in drug-label warnings and cancer text.

modes.label: Tumor word endings
modes.description: The ending of tumor, carcinoma or sarcoma, or the word tumors itself.
modes.example: Pioglitazone Tum<<ors>> were observed in the urinary bladder of male

modes.label: Linking word in disease lists
modes.description: An 'and', comma or 'disease' inside a list of organs or conditions.
modes.example: Sleisenger and Fordtran's Gastrointestinal<< and>> Liver Disease .

card.plain: It lights up on tumor and cancer words and on list words that sit around them.
